title: Time
summary: A moment as the place needs it: today the time, yesterday «вчера, 19:40», then the date, relative within the first hour, with the full date and time in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus, inside a time element. The words are core's SF.format; the element draws itself again while relative and at midnight.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

datetime.description: The moment, ISO 8601 with its offset (2026-11-09T14:32:00+03:00) or milliseconds. Empty or not a date: the element draws nothing

format.description: auto: within threshold of now relative («28 минут назад»), today the time («14:32»), yesterday «вчера, 19:40», this year the day and month («5 ноября»), older the date with the year («30 дек. 2025 г.»); time: «14:32»; date: «9 ноября»; datetime: the full moment («9 ноября 2026 г. в 14:32»); relative: always relative

now.description: The moment auto and relative count from, ISO 8601; empty: the reader's clock, and the element draws itself again each minute while it is relative and at the reader's midnight. A fixed now is for tests and documentation

threshold.description: For auto: how long from now the moment stays relative, an ISO 8601 duration (PT1H, PT15M, P1D). Past it auto says the time or the date

tooltip.description: auto: when the text is not the full moment, the full date and time show in a tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus (Escape hides it), and the element is a Tab stop unless it stands inside a link or a button; none: no tooltip and no Tab stop (a day heading's date, a place that already says the moment)

forbidden_client_responsibilities: formatting the moment by hand (the words are SF.format's)

keyboard: Tab reaches a time with a tooltip (not inside a link or a button) and shows the full moment; Escape hides it
accessibility.focus: A Tab stop only with a tooltip and outside a link or a button.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-time wherever a moment is shown: a list's or a table's «when», a message's time, «изменено …» in a record head, a file version, a notification.
do_not: Do not format a date by hand next to it; give the moment and choose format
Do not use format relative in a table or a log; auto keeps it to the first hour
Do not put a title attribute on it; the tooltip says the moment
